modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_allowance.value: Moana Economy and Mānava Premium: 1 bag of 10 kg (22 pounds) + 1 personal item of 3 kg (6.6pounds). Poerava Business: 1 bag of 12 kg (26.6 pounds) + 1 personal item of 3 kg.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: All cabin baggage must be less than or equal to 115 cm / 45 inches (sum of the 3 dimensions A + B + C).

personal_item.value: One personal item per passenger (handbag, small backpack, laptop bag, briefcase and similar), maximum 3 kg, which must fit under the seat in front of you.

infant.value: Infants (0-23 months) without a seat: one personal item of 3kg (6.6pounds).

modules.lede: Cabin bags are examined before boarding; a non-compliant bag must be checked in and charges may apply.

modules.title: Checked baggage

allowance.value: On flights operated by Air Tahiti Nui: Moana Economy 1 bag of 23 kg (50.7 pounds); Mānava Premium 2 bags of 23 kg; Poerava Business 2 bags of 32 kg (70.5 pounds). Club Tiare Silver and Gold members get 1 extra bag.

size_weight.value: Maximum 32 kg (about 70.5 pounds) per checked bag (heavier items go as cargo), and the sum of the 3 dimensions must be 158 cm / 62.2 inches or less, including pockets, wheels and handles.

infant.value: Infants (0-23 months) without a seat, all classes: 1 bag of 10 kg (22 pounds) + 1 cane stroller, baby cot or car seat.

extra_bag_fees.value: Extra bag, between Australia and USA, Canada, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Japan or Asia: AUD 120; between Australia and other destinations: AUD 200. Between French Polynesia and AU, NZ, USA, Canada or New Caledonia: XPF 8 000; and France: XPF 10 000; and other destinations: XPF 12 000. Different fees apply to flights departing from the United States and Canada.

modules.lede: If you booked directly with Air Tahiti Nui, your baggage allowance is shown on your electronic ticket.
